description: This file defines functions for making API requests to OpenAI's chat response endpoint, handling streaming responses, MCP events, code interpreter events, and associated side effects. It primarily contains a single exported function 'makeOpenAIResponsesRequest' that manages the request and response processing.

methods.name: makeOpenAIResponsesRequest
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous streaming request to the OpenAI responses API, handling various event types such as MCP events, code interpreter events, text deltas, reasoning content, and final response, updating UI components and invoking callback functions as appropriate.
